claim_boundary: logical single-process worker sensitivity and exact training-work accounting; not wall-clock or multi-process speedup
parameter_policy: reuse the d=100, m=8 frozen candidates without worker-specific retuning

evaluation_interval_policy.purpose: keep training work between checkpoints approximately invariant within each method as worker count changes
evaluation_interval_policy.note: ME-DOL checkpoints are restricted to complete 12-round epochs; its reference-worker effective interval is therefore 12 rather than the generic value 4

calibration_acceptance_rule: both primary epsilons must have confirmed hits for every method-worker pair on seed 301; otherwise formal primary thresholds are reduced before any formal worker run
planned_primary_endpoint: within-method same-seed confirmed-first-hit depth versus worker count
planned_secondary_endpoints: within-method first-hit total work and per-worker work versus worker count
terminal total work remains at or immediately below the common budget
terminal per-worker work is approximately inversely proportional to worker count
terminal stationarity proxy remains numerically stable
